lateral_acceleration_estimate.method: Absolute unwrapped native body yaw change over 0.5 s divided by 0.5 s, times trapezoidal mean native speed in m/s over those same six exposures. Overlapping windows sampled every 0.1 s. Includes stopped frames. Each junction observation lies entirely within one fixed junction interior. Kinematic estimate excludes tire slip, body roll, suspension and seat acceleration.
